It has been a few months since I was genuinely active on LinkedIn not because work stopped, but because life outside work was changing in the most beautiful ways.

In the last few months, I got married, packed up my life, and moved to a new country. And today evening, while sitting on my couch with a cup of tea, I suddenly found myself thinking about how far life has brought me.

As professionals, we are often quick to share promotions, projects, awards and professional milestones. But somewhere along the way, we forget to pause and celebrate the personal moments that shape us just as deeply and often influence the direction our professional lives eventually take.

It has now been a month in Poland. I honestly do not know yet what my professional journey here will look like, but I am enjoying the uncertainty, the newness and the experience of starting again.

As I settle into this chapter, I also hope to share more of what I observe and learn about the legal and regulatory systems in India and Poland and the practices that, in my view, both countries could learn from each other.

For now, sharing a few pictures from one of the happiest chapters of my life. 🤍
